rv.q: Michael Longhurst’s surefooted production is both entertaining and deeply moving.
Maybe my own uncertainty about whether this is the cleverest play in town or simply Love Story with extra physics is proof that we live in a world of infinite possibilities.
Longhurst’s surefooted production is both entertaining and deeply moving.

cn.t: Payne's experimental two-hander uses quantum physics as a metaphor for romance in this brain-teasing 70-minute play. Critics praise the innovative form and strong performances, though some find the emotional climax undermines its own scientific principles.
